title: Scientists Used AI to Create 16 New Viruses
summary: This breakthrough opens up new possibilities for combating bacterial resistance . Of the 300 synthesized genomes, only 16 gave rise to fully functional bacteriophages, featuring previously unpublished sequences, different genes, new regulatory elements, and even varying genome sizes.
